$comment: Real-world corpus manifest (F-04 / B1). Populated with verified immutable entries: every URL pins an exact revision, and every sha256/size was measured from the downloaded bytes and cross-checked against the hosting server's own content digest (Hugging Face LFS sha256) for the same revision. While this list is empty the runner exits 0 vacuously; with entries populated it verifies downloads and compares safegguf verdicts. NEVER invent URLs, sha256 digests, sizes or license claims - every populated entry must come from a verifiable primary source and sha256 is the authoritative identity.

entry_schema.name: stable entry id used in reports (unique non-empty string)
entry_schema.url: immutable download URL pinned to a revision (http/https; no moving refs)
entry_schema.revision: optional immutable source revision the URL pins (recorded so the pin is auditable without parsing the URL)
entry_schema.sha256: lowercase hex sha256 of the exact file bytes (authoritative identity)
entry_schema.size: declared file size in bytes (positive integer; verified against the streamed download)
entry_schema.license: license identifier as verified from the source (never guessed)
entry_schema.license_source: optional primary source documenting the license identifier (used where the hosting repository does not declare the license itself)
entry_schema.expected_profile: expected safegguf verdict per profile, e.g. {"gguf-spec": "pass", "llama-cpp": "pass"}; values: pass | reject
